**Calculation (FY2024, per Meta's FY2024 10-K):**

- Income from operations: $69,380 million [DOC-1]
- Revenue: $164,501 million [DOC-1]
- Operating margin = $69,380 ÷ $164,501 = 42.2%

Comparability note: no adjustment issues arise here — both figures are drawn from the same consolidated statements of income for the same fiscal year ended December 31, 2024, as reported in the same filing [DOC-1]. (For context only, the same statement shows FY2023 operating margin of $46,751 ÷ $134,902 = 34.7% and FY2022 of $28,944 ÷ $116,609 = 24.8% [DOC-1].)

ANSWER: ≈42.2% (operating income of $69,380M on revenue of $164,501M)
